description: Surface scraping, masonry crack filling, acrylic wall putty skimming, abrasive sanding, primer application, roller emulsion painting, and exterior waterproof coating on buildings.
daily_tasks: Scraping old loose flaking paint and plaster efflorescence with steel scrapers
Mixing white-cement and acrylic wall putty powder into smooth paste
Applying first and second coats of wall putty with steel application blades
Hand-sanding dried putty surfaces with progressive sandpaper (grades 120 and 220)
Applying water-based primer coats using rollers to seal porous substrates
Rolling interior and exterior acrylic emulsion paints in cross-lap patterns
Cutting-in ceiling and door frame perimeter edges with fine sash brushes
advanced_tasks: Applying specialty metallic and rustic textured wall finishes with trowels and stencils
Waterproofing exterior masonry facades with elastomeric crack-bridging coatings
Hand-rubbing wood finishes with multi-layer French spirit polish and polyurethane sealer
Custom on-site paint tinting and colour matching by eye
work_processes: Surface Scraping -> Primer Mist Coat -> Double Putty Skimming -> Sanding Smoothing -> Sealing Primer -> First Emulsion Coat -> Defect Touchup -> Final Finish Coat
troubleshooting_tasks: Remediating efflorescence and paint blistering caused by underlying wall dampness
Feathering out putty blade lap lines during fine sanding
Eliminating roller lap marks by maintaining a continuous wet paint edge
Fixing paint runs and sags by sanding when dry and re-coating
quality_inspection: Shining tangential inspection light across walls to verify zero hollows or scratch lines
Checking uniform paint film opacity without underlying putty shadows
Verifying razor-sharp clean perimeter lines around switchboards and ceiling cornices
Ensuring zero paint drips or splatters on customer tile floors and windows
measurement_and_planning: Calculating wall surface area and paint volume based on spreading rate (sq ft per liter)
Planning drying intervals between putty coats (min 4-6 hours) and paint coats
safety_practices: Wearing particulate dust respirators when dry-sanding wall putty
Maintaining 3-point ladder safety contact when painting elevated walls
Ensuring cross-ventilation when working with solvent-based enamel paints
Masking electrical outlets to prevent paint entry into live contacts
maintenance: Washing paint rollers and brushes in clean water immediately after use
Scraping dried putty buildup from steel application blades to maintain straight edges
Sealing partial paint cans airtight to prevent surface skin formation
customer_communication: Advising homeowners on washable vs non-washable paint finishes
Reviewing paint shade color cards under natural room daylight conditions
Estimating total job duration and masking furniture precautions

official_vocational_references.ssc: Construction Skill Development Council of India

canonical_skills: Blade Application of Double Coat Wall Putty
Abrasive Sanding and Wall Primer Sealing
Roller Application of Exterior Acrylic Emulsion
